spans.text: The Family is the largest known crime organization in Retia. They reach out beyond the borders of the continent, but their main interests lie within Retia. Their ranks are swollen with assassins, thugs, information brokers, and mages studying illegal magic.

Though not listed in their stat blocks, all Family members carry a ward on them that aids against any Divination magic that would target them. When a Family member would make a save against such an effect, they do so with advantage.

“The Family has so many plates spinning it’s hard to keep track of them all. Their ground-level operations usually involve small gangs and thugs, but when you begin following their paper trail, you quickly find that politicians, thanes, lords, and even some High-Lords have been in their ranks. They buy land, they hoard knowledge, they extort, and they kill. Their M.O. is total social control, but their true core goal has yet to be revealed.”
